car.hook: Asking AI to sell your car?
car.task: I need to sell my car, a VW Polo, and buy a new one, perhaps a Golf.
insertions: Two binding offers set the floor
Inspect any used car before you buy
Check a Golf fits how you drive
car.payoff: Same task. The method a dealer would use.

downloads.hook: Even this has an expert version.
insertions: Find duplicates by hash, not by name
Flag files that exist nowhere else
Count every file before and after

book.hook: “The margins look too big.” Do they?
book.task: Evaluate the typesetting of my book manuscript. The inner margins look exceedingly large.
insertions: Treat that as a guess to test
Print a proof at 100% and look
book.payoff: What a book typographer checks first.

vercel.hook: Leaving Vercel? Ask it like this.
vercel.task: Can we move our Next.js app off Vercel to Cloudflare?
insertions: Build it with the OpenNext adapter
Answer yes, no or not yet
vercel.payoff: A platform engineer's checklist, in your prompt.

blind.intro: Five real tasks, rewritten with and without deeper. A judge on another model scored them without knowing which was which.
blind.payoff: Average out of 5. Five tasks is a small test, and every prompt is public.

scope.intro: In 40 of my own runs, 33 asked for work I hadn't asked for. So 1.1 keeps your scope.
